settings.label: Enabled
settings.desc: Turns the demo on or off.

settings.label: Mode
settings.desc: Pick one with Left / Right. The variable holds the index: 0 = Easy.

settings.label: Distance
settings.desc: A number box with decimals, no range.

settings.label: Seed
settings.desc: A number box with whole numbers, no range.

settings.label: Tint
settings.desc: A colour: red, green and blue, each 0 to 255.

settings.label: Ping
settings.desc: A button: your nodes run when it is pressed.

settings.label: Hotkey
settings.desc: A key picker: A / Enter, then a key (F-keys, Insert, Home, number pad). Delete clears it.
